notes.title: 1.1.0 Update + Steam Deck support!
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing this game with many players!
We made an update to 1.1.0 because we want more players to play this game.

[h1]Function[/h1]
Steam Deck supported.
(MacOS)Notarized to suppress the warning.
Graphics improved.
Enabled Nintendo Switch Pro controller.
[h1]Bug fix[/h1]
Key config was not enabled when using Steam Input with Xbox One controller.
The sound crack was fixed.

Regards,
TamTamGames

notes.title: Changed release day!
notes.notes:
Because they suddenly revealed the release day of the big title, 21 Jul, we proceeded our work for review in a hurry!
Fortunately, we completed the review process of all platforms, we will push the release button on 20 Jul 0:00(PST)!
If you finished stacked games before the big title, try our game!
